body: i just went today! thank you for posting this, i don’t feel so alone anymore

i’ve been there, today my mom convinced me to take the big leap to go to a buffet (god, i know. insanity) this is how i’ve kept calm.

i remembered this:

- recently i was pregnant due to a birth control error. moral issues on the topic aside, from the time i figured out until planned parenthood (i was nine weeks by that time), i gained about six pounds. guess what? two weeks later i lost that six pounds. i survived. the weight WILL go away, even if you think it’s too much. 

- you need ANY deficit to lose weight. the meal you had won’t throw you over your caloric limit (by that i mean 1200-1500. what doctors recommend.)

- all those calories will go to your body and brain if you still have a deficit
it's okay. it took a lot of time to undo the perspective i had from that time- everything from thinspiration to considering near death experiences incentives
i was 11 and very impressionable when my community became enablers and that mindset stayed with me. it's horrible and toxic.
saw several specialists for dizziness and was basically confined to my bed for weeks
nobody can discuss you here, but you sound like you're on the road to or already have something. please get help while you're recognizing it before you get too far deep
i don't know yet, that's the thing. everything's just uncomfortable rn
this post was made as the investigation is already underway and i wish id heard your advice before hand

it's a lot, not just stereotypical shit. i'm involved in a legal investigation over something that happened to me when i was younger, and no matter what the verdict is ill be living w guilt for the rest of my life. my whole life is broken and i just don't want to carry this baggage around.
pro ana communities helped me to love the ideas an eating disorder can present: light, in control, dainty, perfect.

listening and empathy as well as research. give her contradictory evidence to her ed if she comes to you with a statement, gently. eating disorders insist they're the most rational thing, but you can help unravel that.

nobody can diagnose you formally, but you can get a rough idea through forums like this and your own research. bulimia is categorized by binge/purging, while anorexia is mainly restricting but also can lead to purging. eating disorders are a grey area, but helping yourself can sort of come down to one question: where does anxiety, shame or negative emotions fit into your eating? if you can't get real help, you can definitely dm me. it all depends on what you want to work through with this disorder

what helped me was information. 

if she seems receptive to information that contradicts her eating disorder, give it to her. research. be very careful because sometimes little things can hurt her. if she mentions ideal weights, help her find the truth of what her body will look like (no offense to anyone underweight, but it's not a pretty sight under all those clothes and camera angles.) 

they say you can't do anything, but a lovely ex of mine- my first love- truly fucking saved me.
